en: Raise `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` to 1.32.1 and `undici` to 7.30.1, pin patched `proxy-addr`, `fast-uri` and `ip-address` versions, and replace `fast-glob` and `gray-matter` with `tinyglobby` and the existing `yaml` parser so the production dependency audit is clean again.
zh-CN: 将 `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 升至 1.32.1、`undici` 升至 7.30.1，锁定已修补的 `proxy-addr`、`fast-uri` 和 `ip-address` 版本，并用 `tinyglobby` 和已有的 `yaml` 解析器替换 `fast-glob` 与 `gray-matter`，使生产依赖审计重新通过。
